summary: scripts/st-test runs rust-tests by default, after linux-gate, and signs the crates that have no note from linux-gate's own nextest report instead of testing them again, so every push carries per-crate notes at no extra test time

replay.detail: CI and local tooling only; no product code changes.

compatibility.detail: No product contract change. linux-gate's command, lane and policy are unchanged; the rust-tests gate is in shadow.
